recalls.summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Mazda3 vehicles.  A defective windshield wiper relay may cause the windshield wipers to become inoperative, reducing the driver's visibility.

Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2018 Mazda3 vehicles, equipped with an incorrect exhaust valve spring.  The incorrect exhaust valve spring may fail while driving, potentially causing an engine stall.

Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2018 Mazda3, Mazda6, 2019 CX-3, 2018-2019 MX-5, CX-5, CX-9, and 2019-2020 Mazda2 vehicles.  The impeller inside the low-pressure fuel pump may crack and deform, potentially causing the fuel pump to fail.

recalls.summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2014-2018 Mazda3 and 2016-2021 CX-3 vehicles.  The rearview camera image may not display properly by showing a flickering or distorted image.
